0022600023.text: The Golden State Warriors (2-3, 10th in the West) host the Los Angeles Lakers (3-1, 1st in the Pacific) in the Warriors' 6th game of the season, with Golden State at 0-1 at home, 2-2 on the road, and riding a two-game winning streak, while the Lakers have lost their last game. Golden State is missing Gui Santos (knee tendinitis), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Los Angeles is missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation), Cameron Carr (oblique strain), Luka Doncic (back), and Ziaire Williams (foot). In the season series, the Warriors trail 0-1 in 2026-27 after a 127-105 loss in Los Angeles on 2026-10-21, and they lost 1-3 to the Lakers in 2025-26.
